news.title: 'Legend' Pete Rose receives posthumous presidential pardon from Trump
news.summary: President Donald Trump said he has posthumously pardoned Pete Rose more than two years after the baseball star's death and a year after he was reinstated by MLB.

news.title: Rockies trade for ChiSox's Castillo, Martin
news.summary: The Rockies acquired pitchers Luis Castillo and Davis Martin from the White Sox for left-hander Sean Sullivan and catching prospect Douglas Veliz.

news.title: Source: Mets begin rebuilding bullpen, reach 3-year deal with Hernandez
news.summary: The Mets reached a three-year, $12 million deal with Darwinzon Hernandez, a source told ESPN, helping a relief corps that underwent an overhaul this past summer.

news.title: Welcome back: Twins reunite with veteran RHP Gray on two-year deal
news.summary: The Twins have signed free agent right-hander Sonny Gray to a two-year contract, the team announced. The deal is for $55 million and includes an opt-out after the first season, sources told ESPN's Jef...

news.title: Manfred says MLB owners won't OK deal without cap as lockout looms
news.summary: Commissioner Rob Manfred said owners will not accept any deal without a salary cap, leaving MLB on track for a lockout that could threaten the 2027 season.
